name: White Grime f -Bouken ni Shippai Shita Mahoutsukai no Hanashi-
original_name: white grime f -冒険に失敗した魔法使いの話-
source:
Karena the young girl mage fell into a monster's trap. 

Her arms and legs were spread wide by tentacle lovers. 
As the world turned lusty purple she drowned in good feelings. 
Waterfalls of sticky semen washed her guts of any 
semblance of her former self. Her body became a choked vessel 
for the burbling jizzum of her endless tormenters. 

A new entry in the WHitE GRiME visual novel series.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE102408.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年轻的女法师凯琳娜落入了怪物的陷阱。

她的手臂和腿被触手爱好者张开。
当世界变成紫色时，她沉浸在美好的感觉中。
粘稠的精液如瀑布般冲刷掉了她的内脏。
她与以前的自己相似。她的身体变成了一个窒息的血管 
为她无尽的折磨者带来的潺潺精液。

WHitE GRiME视觉小说系列的新作品。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE102408.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
